A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low at $68.25 compared to the 20-day low of $67.93. The current price of $72.37 is 17.95% above the SMA200, a high position relative to ATR at 3.90%. Weekly RSI is 54.7 and weekly MACD histogram is -0.9006, both in neutral zones. The 4-hour RSI is 52.1 and MACD histogram is 0.3293, aligning with the daily chart. While the overall market sentiment has shifted to 60% positive vs. 40% negative, this specific instrument has not yet generated clear trend-reversal signals. With the target allocation of 1x leverage filled, further leverage review awaits stronger signals.
